question.question: If Marquise Recruit has more eligible recruiters than available warriors, what is placed and who chooses where?

expected.expected_answer: Once-per-turn Recruit places one per recruiter as far as supply allows; maximum available, Marquise chooses eligible placements when shortage.

source_passages.quotation: - **Recruit:** One warrior at **each recruiter**; only **once per turn**. If supply cannot fill all recruiters, place maximum available, choosing among eligible recruiters.

answer.ruling: Recruit normally places one warrior at each recruiter and can be taken only once per turn. If supply cannot fill all recruiters, place the maximum available warriors and choose which eligible recruiters receive them.
